5º de Primaria · Inglés

Prepositions of place and time

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

En castellano decimos «en la mesa», «en abril» y «el lunes». En inglés, ¿«en» siempre es in?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

No. Las preposiciones inglesas son más precisas. Para lugares, in es «dentro» (in the box) y on es «encima» (on the table). Para el tiempo usamos in con meses y años (in April), on con días (on Monday) y at con horas (at five o'clock).

2

Aprende14 apartados

Para empezar: The treasure map

Last summer, Marco and his cousin Elsa found an old map in a box under Grandpa's bed. At the top, it said: «The treasure is waiting for you.»

They followed the instructions carefully:

«Walk out of the house and go across the garden. Go through the little gate and walk along the river. Go over the old wooden bridge and walk past the big rock. Climb up the hill. At the top, there is a tall pine tree. The treasure is between the tree and the stone wall, under the ground.»

Marco and Elsa ran up the hill. They were tired, but they started to dig next to the wall. After ten minutes, they found a metal box. They opened it and… inside there were old photos, some coins and a letter!

The letter said: «Dear grandchildren, the real treasure is the adventure. Now come back home before dinner. Grandma has made a cake. Love, Grandpa.»

They ran down the hill laughing. It was the best treasure hunt of the summer.

(Las preposiciones de movimiento indican hacia dónde vamos: across, through, along, over, past, up, down.)

1. Where is it?

Prepositions of place tell us where something is. The basic ones are: in (dentro de): «The pencil is in the pencil case.» on (encima de, tocando): «The book is on the desk.» under (debajo de): «The cat is under the bed.»

We ask with Where is…? or Where are…?: «Where are my trainers?» «They're under the sofa!» En castellano: «en» puede ser in o on. Pregúntate: ¿está dentro o encima?

2. Next to, between, behind…

More prepositions of place: next to (al lado de): «Lucas sits next to Emma.» between (entre dos cosas): «The bank is between the bakery and the pharmacy.» behind (detrás de): «The garden is behind the house.» in front of (delante de): «There's a tree in front of my window.»

opposite (enfrente de, al otro lado): «The school is opposite the park.» near (cerca de): «I live near the beach.» Ojo: in front of es «delante de», no «enfrente».

3. Prepositions of movement

Prepositions of place tell us where something is. Prepositions of movement tell us where something goes. We use them with verbs like go, walk, run, jump, swim, drive, fly:

  • into (hacia dentro de) / out of (fuera de): «The cat jumped into the box.» «She ran out of the classroom.»
  • up (hacia arriba) / down (hacia abajo): «We climbed up the mountain and ran down.»
  • across (de un lado a otro, cruzando): «Walk across the street.»
  • through (a través de, por dentro): «The train goes through a tunnel.»
  • along (a lo largo de): «We walked along the beach.»
  • over (por encima de): «The horse jumped over the fence.»
  • under (por debajo de): «The boat went under the bridge.»
  • past (por delante de, pasando): «Walk past the church.»
  • around (alrededor de): «The Earth goes around the Sun.»
  • towards (hacia): «The dog ran towards me.»

Compare: in the box (place, quieto) and into the box (movement, entra).

4. Describing my bedroom

Prepositions are perfect to describe a room. «My bed is next to the window. There's a rug on the floor and a box of toys under the bed. My desk is opposite the door. My books are on the shelf, between the lamp and the plant. My clothes are in the wardrobe… well, some of them are on the chair!»

Use There is (one) and There are (more than one): «There are two posters on the wall.» «There is a clock above the door.» above = encima, sin tocar.

5. Giving directions

In a town we use prepositions to give directions. Useful phrases: go straight on (sigue recto), turn left (gira a la izquierda), turn right (a la derecha), take the first street on the left, cross the road (cruza la calle).

«Excuse me, where's the library?» «Go straight on and turn right. The library is next to the post office, opposite the park.» «Thank you!» Remember to be polite: start with Excuse me and finish with Thank you.

6. Places in town and asking the way

To ask and give directions, you need to know the names of places in town:

  • Shops: bakery (panadería), butcher's (carnicería), chemist's / pharmacy (farmacia), bookshop (librería), supermarket.
  • Services: post office (correos), bank, hospital, police station, fire station, town hall (ayuntamiento), library (biblioteca, ¡no librería!).
  • Leisure: cinema, museum, park, sports centre, swimming pool, square (plaza).
  • Transport: bus stop, train station, traffic lights (semáforo), roundabout (rotonda), corner (esquina).

To ask the way politely, start with Excuse me:

  • «Excuse me, how do I get to the museum?»
  • «Excuse me, is there a chemist's near here?»
  • «Excuse me, where is the train station?»

Possible answers: «Go straight on and turn left at the traffic lights. The museum is on the right, opposite the park.» «It's on the corner of Main Street and Sun Street.» «It's about five minutes on foot.»

Don't forget to say Thank you! And if you don't understand, ask: «Sorry, can you repeat that, please?»

7. When? In, on and at

Prepositions of time tell us when. The three most important are in, on and at. Think of a pyramid. In is for big periods: months, seasons, years and centuries: in May, in winter, in 2015, in the 21st century.

On is for days and dates: on Monday, on my birthday, on 3rd June, on Christmas Day. At is for exact times: at seven o'clock, at half past four, at midnight, and also at the weekend and at night.

Vídeo: In, on, at: preposiciones de tiempo para niños · Inglés para niños con Mr Pea (YouTube) · 749 mil visualizaciones

8. At home, in bed, on the bus

Some expressions with prepositions are fixed: we must learn them as a block, because Spanish uses different prepositions or none.

  • With at: at home, at school, at work, at the cinema, at a party, at the top / at the bottom, at the door. «I'm at home.» (not «in home»)
  • With in: in bed, in hospital, in the car, in a taxi, in the sky, in the picture, in the middle. «There's a bird in the sky.»
  • With on: on the bus, on the train, on a plane, on a bike, on TV, on the radio, on the internet, on the left / on the right, on the wall. «I saw it on TV.»
  • With by (transport, without «the»): by bus, by car, by train, by plane. But: on foot (a pie).

Notice the difference: «I go to school by bus» (how) but «I read a book on the bus» (where).

And remember: we say go home, without «to»: «I go home at five.» But «I go to school», «I go to the park».

Vídeo: Prepositions of Time – English Grammar Lessons · Ellii (formerly ESL Library) (YouTube) · 1,4 millones de visualizaciones

9. Parts of the day

Be careful with the parts of the day. We say in the morning, in the afternoon and in the evening, but at night. «I have English in the morning.» «We go to the park in the afternoon.» «Owls hunt at night.»

If we add a day, we use on: «on Monday morning», «on Saturday night». And with this, next, last, every we don't use any preposition: «I'll see you next Friday», «We play every Tuesday», «I went last summer».

10. Time and place together

Many sentences have both: where and when. The usual order in English is: place first, then time. «I play football in the park on Saturdays.» «We had lunch at my grandma's at two o'clock.» «My cousin was born in Seville in 2016.»

Truco: «¿Dónde? ¿Cuándo?», en ese orden. También podemos poner el tiempo al principio para destacarlo: «On Saturdays, I play football in the park».

11. Before, after, during, until…

Besides in, on and at, there are other prepositions of time that you will need very often:

  • before (antes de): «Wash your hands before lunch.»
  • after (después de): «We play football after school.»
  • during (durante): «Don't talk during the exam.» «I sleep during the journey.»
  • from… to / until (de… a / hasta): «The shop is open from nine to two.» «I study from Monday to Friday.» «Wait until six.»
  • for (durante, con una cantidad de tiempo): «I played for two hours.» «We stayed in London for a week.»
  • since (desde): «I've lived here since 2020.» (You will use it more in the future.)

Careful with during and for: both can be «durante» in Spanish. Use during + an event or period (during the film, during the summer) and for + a quantity of time (for ten minutes, for three days).

«During the summer holidays I went to the beach for two weeks.»

12. Reading: the school trip

Read the note from the teacher: «Dear families, our school trip to the Natural Park is on Friday 14th May. We meet at the school gate at half past eight in the morning. The bus stops in front of the gym. At the park, we will have lunch under the big trees, next to the river. The information centre is opposite the car park. We come back at five o'clock in the afternoon. Please put a hat and a water bottle in your child's bag.»

When is the trip? Where does the bus stop? Where will they have lunch?

13. Let's practise: hide and find

Play «Where's the rubber?» One student hides a rubber in the classroom while another waits outside. Then the class gives clues: «It's near the board. It's under something. It's between two books.»

Second game: «My week». Tell your partner three activities with in, on, at: «I have swimming on Tuesday at six. In summer I go to the village.» Repaso: lugar: in, on, under, next to, between, behind, in front of, opposite. Tiempo: in (mes, año), on (día), at (hora).

14. Above, below, inside, outside

Here are some more prepositions of place that will help you describe pictures and places with more detail:

  • above (encima de, por encima, sin tocar) / below (debajo de, por debajo, sin tocar): «The lamp is above the table.» «The temperature is below zero.» Compare: on the table (touching) and above the table (not touching).
  • inside (dentro) / outside (fuera): «It's raining. Let's stay inside.» «The children are playing outside.»
  • among (entre muchos): «I found my pen among the books.» Compare: between two things, among three or more.
  • against (apoyado en, contra): «The bike is against the wall.»
  • at the top of / at the bottom of: «The castle is at the top of the hill.» «Write your name at the bottom of the page.»
  • in the middle of (en medio de): «There's a fountain in the middle of the square.»
  • in the corner of (en la esquina, dentro de una habitación): «The TV is in the corner of the living room.»

Use them to describe a picture: «In the middle of the picture there is a house. Above the house there are some birds. Outside the house, two children are playing among the trees…» This is a great game for pairs: one describes a picture and the other draws it without looking.

Ejemplos resueltos

Ejemplo 1. Complete: «The keys are ___ my bag.» (dentro)

  1. Dentro de algo: in.

Resultado: The keys are in my bag.

Ejemplo 2. Complete with in, on or at: «My birthday is ___ March, ___ the 9th.»

  1. Mes: in.
  2. Fecha concreta: on.

Resultado: My birthday is in March, on the 9th.

Ejemplo 3. Order the sentence: «at 10 / to the cinema / we went»

  1. Primero lugar, después tiempo.

Resultado: We went to the cinema at 10.

Ejemplo 4. Choose: «The cat is ___ the box.» / «The cat jumped ___ the box.» (in / into)

  1. Is = position, no movement → in.
  2. Jumped = movement towards the inside → into.

Resultado: The cat is in the box. The cat jumped into the box.

Ejemplo 5. During or for? «I slept ___ the film. I slept ___ two hours.»

  1. The film is an event → during.
  2. Two hours is a quantity of time → for.

Resultado: I slept during the film. I slept for two hours.

Errores típicos

  • Traducir siempre «en» por in: «in the table» → «on the table».
  • Confundir in front of (delante) con opposite (enfrente).
  • Usar in con los días: «in Monday» → «on Monday».
  • Decir «in the night» → «at night».
  • Poner preposición con next, last, every: «on next Friday» → «next Friday».
  • Decir «in home» o «go to home»: es «at home» y «go home».
  • Confundir library (biblioteca) con bookshop (librería).

Ejercicios (24)

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

Nivel básico

  1. Translate: a través de, a lo largo de, cruzando.

    Ver solución
    through, along, across.

  2. Complete: «I go to school ___ bus. My friend goes ___ foot.»

    Ver solución
    by, on.

  3. Write three places in town where you can buy things.

    Ver solución
    Example: bakery, chemist's, supermarket.

  4. Complete: «Wash your hands ___ lunch.» (before / during)

    Ver solución
    before.

  5. Complete with at, in or on: «___ home», «___ bed», «___ TV».

    Ver solución
    at home, in bed, on TV.

Nivel medio

  1. Complete: «The milk is ___ the fridge.»

    Ver solución
    in.

  2. Complete: «The picture is ___ the wall.»

    Ver solución
    on.

  3. Complete: «The dog sleeps ___ the table.» (debajo)

    Ver solución
    under.

  4. Complete: «The B is ___ the A and the C.»

    Ver solución
    between.

  5. Complete with in, on or at: «___ summer», «___ Sunday», «___ 6 o'clock».

    Ver solución
    in summer, on Sunday, at 6 o'clock.

  6. Complete: «I read ___ night and I run ___ the morning.»

    Ver solución
    at night, in the morning.

  7. Correct: «I was born on 2015 in July.»

    Ver solución
    I was born in July 2015. / I was born in 2015.

  8. Translate: «La farmacia está enfrente del colegio.»

    Ver solución
    The pharmacy is opposite the school.

  9. Give directions: go up the street and turn left.

    Ver solución
    Go straight on and turn left.

  10. Describe your desk in three sentences.

    Ver solución
    Model answer: My pencil case is on the desk. My bag is under the desk. The lamp is next to the books.

  11. Write the question to ask the way to the library politely.

    Ver solución
    Excuse me, how do I get to the library?

  12. Correct: «I go to home at five and I watch a film in TV.»

    Ver solución
    I go home at five and I watch a film on TV.

  13. Between or among? «Lucía sits ___ Ana and Pablo.» / «There's a mouse ___ the leaves.»

    Ver solución
    between, among.

  14. Complete: «The shop is open ___ nine ___ two.»

    Ver solución
    from, to.

  15. Describe the route in the treasure map with four prepositions of movement.

    Ver solución
    Example: out of the house, across the garden, through the gate, over the bridge.

Nivel avanzado

  1. Draw a map of your neighbourhood and write directions from your house to your school.

    Ver solución
    Open answer.

  2. Write a treasure hunt for the classroom with five instructions using prepositions of movement and place.

    Ver solución
    Open answer.

  3. Describe a picture of a square with above, in the middle of, next to, in front of and behind.

    Ver solución
    Open answer.

  4. Write a dialogue between a tourist and you in your town: asking the way, giving directions and saying thank you.

    Ver solución
    Open answer.

Explícalo con tus palabrasComo si se lo contaras a alguien de un curso menor

¿Has nombrado estas ideas?
★

Situación de aprendizajeA tourist guide to our town

La clase elabora en inglés una guía turística de su localidad con un mapa, rutas e información de horarios.

Pasos

  1. Draw a map of the centre of your town with the main places in English.
  2. Write three routes from the school to interesting places using directions and prepositions of movement.
  3. Add opening times with from… to, before, after and on + days.
  4. Role-play: some students are tourists who ask the way and the others give directions with the guide.

Producto final: Una guía turística ilustrada con mapa y rutas.

Cómo se valora

  • Uses prepositions of place and movement correctly.
  • Asks and gives directions politely.
  • Uses prepositions of time and fixed expressions.
  • Describes routes clearly.

Tarjetas de repasoToca la tarjeta para darle la vuelta

Según cómo respondas, la tarjeta vuelve mañana, en 3, en 7 o en 21 días.

Para familias

  • Esconded un objeto en casa y dad pistas en inglés con preposiciones.
  • Al hacer la agenda de la semana, decid cada actividad con on + día y at + hora.
  • Repasad juntos las tarjetas del paso 6 dos minutos al día durante una semana.

Para profesores

Saberes: Descripción de lugares y ubicación de objetos; preposiciones de lugar y de tiempo; indicaciones sencillas (Lengua Extranjera) (RD 157/2022, tercer ciclo de Primaria).

  • Plano de la ciudad en la pizarra para dar indicaciones.
  • Juego de esconder la goma con pistas.
  • Pirámide de in, on, at con tarjetas de expresiones de tiempo.

Fuentes y revisión

  • British Council LearnEnglish Kids: prepositions of place
  • Cambridge Dictionary: at, in, on (time)

Revisado el 22 de noviembre de 2026.

Qué vas a aprender

  • Say where things are with prepositions of place (dónde está algo)
  • Use in, on, under, next to, between, behind, in front of and opposite
  • Say when things happen with in, on and at
  • Give simple directions and describe a room
  • Use prepositions of movement and more prepositions of place
  • Ask for and give directions to places in town
  • Use more prepositions of time and fixed expressions like at home or on the bus

Palabras clave

preposition · in · on · under · next to · between · behind · in front of · opposite · at · in + month · on + day · at + time

Tiempo

80 minutos hoy + 2 minutos en cada repaso
